description: Use local formal handoff and inherited worker configuration
changelog: Channel workers inherit their native configuration without a product-specific plugin override or environment filter. Bundled worker guidance uses the normal environment merge contract. The custom Codex workflow uses paired local handoff artifacts, source seals, and native task ownership.
notes: Upgrade the CLI and refresh project assets. Refresh an explicitly selected custom workflow from its updated registry revision. Historical task and handoff records are preserved.
